import pandas as pd

# File paths for source data
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_39/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_39/training_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Source0 schema: ['State', 'Participation', 'English', 'Math', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite']
# Source1 schema: ['State', 'Participation', 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math', 'Total']

# Target schema:
# ['State': string,
#  'Participation_x': string,
#  'English': float,
#  'Math_x': float,
#  'Reading': float,
#  'Science': float,
#  'Composite': float,
#  'Participation_y': string,
#  'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing': integer,
#  'Math_y': integer,
#  'Total': integer]

# Transformation plan:
# - df0 contains academic subject scores and participation (Participation_x)
# - df1 contains participation (Participation_y), Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, Math, and Total
# - Join df0 and df1 on 'State' to combine all columns
# - Rename columns to match target schema:
#   - df0.Participation -> Participation_x
#   - df0.Math -> Math_x (float)
#   - df1.Participation -> Participation_y
#   - df1.Math -> Math_y (integer)
# - Ensure data types match target schema:
#   - Participation_x, Participation_y: string (keep as is)
#   - English, Math_x, Reading, Science, Composite: float
#   - Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, Math_y, Total: integer

# Rename columns in df0 to match target suffixes
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    "Participation": "Participation_x",
    "Math": "Math_x"
})

# Rename columns in df1 to match target suffixes
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    "Participation": "Participation_y",
    "Math": "Math_y"
})

# Join on 'State' (inner join to keep only states present in both sources)
df_merged = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on="State", how="inner")

# Reorder and select columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    "State",
    "Participation_x",
    "English",
    "Math_x",
    "Reading",
    "Science",
    "Composite",
    "Participation_y",
    "Evidence-Based Reading and Writing",
    "Math_y",
    "Total"
]

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Convert data types to match target schema
# Participation_x and Participation_y are strings, no change needed
# English, Math_x, Reading, Science, Composite: float
float_cols = ["English", "Math_x", "Reading", "Science", "Composite"]
df_target[float_cols] = df_target[float_cols].astype(float)

# Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, Math_y, Total: integer
int_cols = ["Evidence-Based Reading and Writing", "Math_y", "Total"]
df_target[int_cols] = df_target[int_cols].astype(int)

# Write the transformed target table to CSV
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_39/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
